summary.headline: Uno Minda Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue rose 18% YoY to INR 5,336 crore with EBITDA margin of 11.3%, but commodity and labour cost pressure is expected to weigh on coming quarters.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue from operations was INR 5,336 crore (+18% YoY) and EBITDA was INR 603 crore (+14%) at an 11.3% margin, both company records. PAT attributable to shareholders rose 22% to INR 326 crore. For FY26, revenue was INR 19,589 crore (+17%), normalised EBITDA INR 2,182 crore (+16%) at 11.1%, and normalised PAT INR 1,166 crore (+24%). Management flagged that aluminium and labour cost spikes (Haryana labour rates up about 35%) are expected to hit coming quarters sizably, and is negotiating faster price pass-through with customers.

segments.name: Switch systems
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 1,343 crore (+17%, 25% of consol), a record quarter; 2-wheeler switches grew over 26% and 2-wheeler switch exports were INR 86 crore. FY26 revenue INR 4,871 crore (+16%).

segments.name: Lighting systems
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 1,154 crore (+13%, about 22% of consol); FY26 INR 4,402 crore (+14%). Management says 4-wheeler lighting is now in consolidation after a threefold expansion over five years.

segments.name: Casting (alloy wheels and die casting)
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 982 crore (+14%, about 18% of consol): 4-wheeler alloy wheels INR 535 crore, 2-wheeler alloy wheels INR 259 crore, die casting INR 188 crore. FY26 INR 3,694 crore (+15%). Aluminium pass-through contributed about 4-5% of growth.

segments.name: Seating systems
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 381 crore (about 7% of consol); FY26 INR 1,416 crore (+23%). Q4 exports INR 54 crore.

segments.name: Green mobility (new reporting segment)
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 423 crore (+25%, 8% of consol): alternate fuels INR 186 crore, 2W/3W EV systems INR 147 crore, 4W EV INR 46 crore, EV controllers INR 44 crore. FY26 INR 1,405 crore (+7% on restated INR 1,313 crore).

segments.name: Others (incl. acoustics, sensors/ADAS, blow moulding, aftermarket)
segments.commentary: Q4 revenue INR 1,053 crore (+25%, about 20% of consol): sensors and ADAS INR 205 crore, acoustics INR 225 crore, blow moulding INR 118 crore, non-EV controllers INR 86 crore. FY26 INR 3,801 crore (+26%). Acoustics was moved into this category.

segments.name: Aftermarket and international
segments.commentary: Q4 aftermarket revenue INR 340 crore (about 7% of consol) plus INR 232 crore to OEM spare parts division. International business was about 10% of Q4 revenue.

guidance_outlook: FY27 consolidated capex planned at about INR 1,750 crore: about INR 650 crore sustaining and about INR 1,100 crore growth, plus land; more land may be needed at CSN, Hosur and Gujarat.
Annual EBITDA margin guided at about 11% plus or minus 50 bps, including known start-up costs of new plants.
Automotive industry expected to sustain growth momentum in FY27; 7 of 11 ongoing projects to commence production or ramp up in FY27.
Sunroof manufacturing commissioning expected by end FY27; EV powertrain Khed Phase 1 expected in H2 FY27.
Physical exports from India (ex overseas plants) of about INR 600 crore in FY26 expected to cross INR 1,500 crore in the next few years.
Labour cost impact of about a couple of hundred crore for Haryana and Gujarat alone, with other states yet to announce floor wages; mitigation via customer pass-through being negotiated.
Expected sizeable commodity-driven margin impact in coming quarters; management seeks shorter pass-through cycles (monthly or quarterly instead of half-yearly).
capex_capacity: Khed City (Pune) EV powertrain facility to begin operations in H2 FY27; Phase 1 of the Kharkhoda/Farrukhnagar-linked programmes also in progress.

New greenfield EV powertrain plant at Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar under UMAIPL: total investment about INR 550 crore, EDU with Inovance Automotive technology partner, DHT through a customer partnership, commissioning by Q2 FY28.
CSN casting plant of about INR 300 crore to serve EDU and DST; combined EV powertrain capex about INR 1,200 crore, revenue potential more than 2x (INR 2,500 crore+, peak up to about INR 3,000 crore).
4-wheeler switch shifting from Manesar to Farrukhnagar expected to complete over the next 6 months; 2-wheeler lighting's three plants being merged into one at Kharkhoda.
Capacity post expansion: about 9.5 million 2-wheeler alloy wheels per year and about 7 million 4-wheeler alloy wheels, based on announced projects.
Commissioned in Q4: 4-wheeler lighting plants at Khed City and Indonesia, 2-wheeler alloy wheel expansion at Supa, 4-wheeler alloy wheel Phase 1 at Kharkhoda, and Bawal expansion.
Sunroof order book potential exceeds INR 350 crore after a new INR 85 crore annual peak order; facility commissioning by end FY27.
demand_pricing: Industry: FY26 PV production a record 5.5 million units (+9%); 2W production a record 26.6 million (+12%); CV production 1.17 million (+13%); 3W Q4 production +32%. Management cited EV penetration of 4.2% in PV and 6.5% in e-2W.

Q4 alloy wheel penetration moderated: 4-wheeler customers shifted mix to entry-level models with lower alloy adoption; in 2W, some programmes switched to steel wheels. Current penetration is about 70% in 2W and about 40% in 4W (as stated).

Pass-through: 3- or 6-month cycles set by customer policy, not by commodity; 1-2 customers operate annually. Management says commodity spikes of 30-40% are not normal and is seeking monthly or quarterly adjustments.

Gross margin compressed by about 1% YoY in Q4, attributed to newer lower-margin businesses and commodity impacts; the trading business (EV-related, about INR 40-45 crore) is too small to be significant.

New wins: 2W lighting order with annual peak value about INR 450 crore (SOP H2 FY28, about 25% of current 2W lighting revenue); 2W silver-box display order about INR 200 crore (production from Q4 FY27); CV seating export orders about INR 390 crore from 3 customers in Europe and North America (supplies from FY28); IVI order about INR 600 crore (SOP Q3 FY29, via Denso JV, outside consolidated revenue).

qa_highlights.question: Why set up a second 4W EV powertrain plant (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar) while Khed is still under construction, and how will the multiple plants (about 9 starting FY27, ~INR 1,800 crore capex) be executed?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited firm customer partnerships for DST and EDU and a customer push to be closer to them; Khed capacity was earmarked for existing businesses. It said one plant commissions this year and the second after about a year. Execution is handled by separate business teams, so no team overlaps across plants. Revenue guidance for the new plant was not given.

qa_highlights.question: What was the Q4 debit/credit note quantum affecting margin, and how much aluminium pass-through and commodity impact was there?
qa_highlights.answer: Quantum of the Q4 debit/credit note adjustments was not shared because it differs by business. Some customer price settlement income was booked in Q4. Aluminium pass-through contributed about 4-5% of casting growth. Commodity impact is expected to be sizable in coming quarters; Haryana labour rates are up about 35%.

qa_highlights.question: How large is the new 4W EV plant revenue potential and how much of the 1.85 lakh capacity is booked?
qa_highlights.answer: Booked share was not disclosed; the 1.85 lakh figure is eventual capacity and will be built as business is won. Khed (INR 400 crore+) and the new plant (INR 550 crore) plus about INR 300 crore CSN casting total about INR 1,200 crore capex, with revenue above 2x, at least INR 2,500 crore and up to about INR 3,000 crore at peak.

qa_highlights.question: What is the EBITDA margin impact from the labour and commodity pressures, and how does pass-through work?
qa_highlights.answer: Labour impact is about a couple of hundred crore for Haryana and Gujarat alone, with other states yet to announce floor wages. Pass-through cycles are set by each customer (3 or 6 months, with 1-2 customers annual), not by commodity. Management is seeking monthly or quarterly adjustments. The 11% plus/minus 50 bps guidance includes known start-up costs.

qa_highlights.question: What are the alloy wheel penetration levels and the 2W alloy wheel and 4W alloy wheel capacity post expansion?
qa_highlights.answer: Current alloy wheel penetration is about 70% in 2W and about 40% in 4W. Capacity post expansion is about 9.5 million 2W alloy wheels per year and about 7 million 4W alloy wheels, based on announced projects.

qa_highlights.question: Why is gross margin down about 1%, and how large is the trading drag?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross margin fell about 1% YoY. Management attributed this to newer lower-margin businesses and commodity impact. The EV-related trading business is about INR 40-45 crore and too small to matter. Exports from India were about INR 600 crore in FY26 and are expected to cross INR 1,500 crore in the next few years.

qa_highlights.question: How big is the Denso JV infotainment (IVI) order and how does it reflect in consolidated numbers?
qa_highlights.answer: The IVI order has annual peak value of about INR 600 crore, with SOP in Q3 FY29 and about 70% of current JV revenue of INR 846 crore. It sits in the Denso JV and is excluded from consolidated revenue, appearing only as share of JV profit. No further new business timing was committed.

risks_watch: Commodity (aluminium) and labour cost spikes (Haryana up about 35%; labour impact about INR 200 crore for Haryana and Gujarat) hit coming quarters, and pass-through cycles of 3-6 months (1-2 customers annual) lag the cost increase.

Start-up costs and execution load as about 7 of 11 projects commence or ramp in FY27, including Khed EV powertrain (H2 FY27), sunroof (end FY27) and CSN/Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar plants; the 11% plus/minus 50 bps EBITDA guidance must absorb these.
Alloy wheel penetration softening (4W mix shift to entry models, 2W programmes switching to steel wheels) could weigh on casting growth.
Capex of about INR 1,750 crore in FY27 and possible additional land at CSN, Hosur and Gujarat; net debt rose to INR 2,179 crore, partly from the INR 200-odd crore FRIWO-linked acquisition.
Q4 debit/credit note adjustments were not quantified, so the underlying Q4 margin base is harder to assess; monitor Q1 FY27 margin and the pass-through reset to monthly or quarterly.
Revenue visibility on the new 4W EV plant is not disclosed; booked share of the 1.85 lakh capacity and revenue timing remain open.
key_quotes: So some of the customers have been positive with some of the customer discussions have been happening, and we still have like 1, 1.5 month for this quarter.
Normally, you expect labor price to be 5%, 7%, 8%, 10% kind of a thing. But 35%, obviously, is not something which can be absorbed easily.
And we expect to complete the transition of Manesar plant to Farrukhnagar over the next 6 months.
But we do expect to absorb all this in our current profitability.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on demand, order wins and FY27 growth, but cautious and somewhat evasive on margins, commodity and labour cost impacts, and the booked share of new EV capacity, repeatedly deferring specifics to offline follow-ups.
